topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: The rain never stops here, seems to seep into every crack, every lie. Got a call from a homeowner, voice trembling, said they found things in the attic. Things from the past, left by folks who vanished without a trace. Said there were photos, old letters, a box of mementos, and a diary that spoke of debts and disappearances. Told me the walls whisper secrets when the rain pounds hard enough. Took the job, of course. Rain's always good for business, and the past has a nasty habit of being more alive than you think. Headed out, kept my coat collar up, shielded the light in my eyes. Some things, they're best left in the dark, but the rain pushes them to the surface, makes you see what you’d rather forget.
